Before v0.1: no deprecated aliases. statementChanged lists the declarations (new names) whose statements changed. Item 1: the Gaussian (RSVD1)/(NysSVD1) tails measure the deviation with the Lipschitz constant ‖S‖₂‖G₁⁺‖₂ instead of ‖S‖_F‖G₁⁺‖_F and keep the concentration exponent: the noise term (utk/d)‖E‖_F² with failure e^{-(u-2)/4} becomes (tk/d)(‖E‖_F + s σ_k)² with failure e^{-s²/2}, s ≥ 0 (Tropp–Webber's printed form is the case s = √u − 1, stated in each docstring). Item 2: the sub-Gaussian JL constant 1/64 → 1/36, from the centred-square parameters (18c², 18c) (new ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF.hasSubexponentialMGF_sq_sub_integral_of_le, every window (v, b) with 2c ≤ b and 16c²b ≤ (b − 2c)v; Honorio–Jaakkola's (32c², 4c) stays as hasSubexponentialMGF_sq_sub_integral), and the net of JL-plus-a-net from radius 1/4 to 1/10 (constants 1 ∓ 2ε, 9^d → 1 ∓ (5/4)ε, 21^d; new Real.log_twentyOne_le_sixtyOne_div_twenty). subgaussianEmbeddingDim becomes 25c²(d log 21 + log(2/δ))/(16Cε²), valid for ε ≤ 5c/4 (was ε ≤ 2c); the sign-sketch OSE sizes become jlDim (4ε/5) (δ/21^d) for ε < 15/8 (was jlDim (ε/2) (δ/9^d), ε < 3). Item 3: subgaussianRangeFinderFactor 1 + 10c → 1 + 5c/2 (the Hsu–Kakade–Zhang threshold at t = log(2/δ) ≤ ℓ/225, which the size hypothesis gives); its explicit bound subgaussianRangeFinderFactor_le changes with it. Item 4: the oblivious early-truncation (1 + ε) form runs the core tail at the optimal Young parameter θ = ε/(6 + ε), which solves the structural quadratic exactly; the budgets ε/8 (injection 1 − ε/8, tails ε/(8√k)‖E‖_F², (ε/8)‖E‖_F) become ε/6, and the CountSketch, Gaussian and sub-Gaussian sizes scale by 9/16. Item 6: Halko–Martinsson–Tropp's deviation bounds (Theorems 10.7, 10.8) are stated in the squared form that the Pythagorean structural bound gives, ‖E‖² + (noise)² in place of (‖E‖ + noise)²; the triangle forms follow by √(a² + b²) ≤ a + b and had no consumer, so (CONTRIBUTING §5.2 rule 6, before v0.1) they are renamed to the squared statements, the new name distinguishing them from Tropp–Webber's squared form by the right-side token gaussianPinvSpecNormBound (rule N8).
